typesense:latest.greeting: You wake groggily in an unfamiliar room.. expensive antique furniture litters the room. A stone fireplace crackles with warmth and orange glow.. the only light in the room. Three wooden, ancient doors set into the walls, visible only due to the lightning flash through the steepled tall windows, upon which a furious cold rain batters. The only sounds the crackling of the fireplace and the rush of rain outside. Where are you? How did you get here?
typesense:latest.name: The Haunted Castle
typesense:latest.title: A spawling labyrinth of a castle you have awoken inside.. are you being watched as explore?
